intro.fr: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub CertifiedPyro/PipistrelloArchipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo.
text.en: The GitHub repository CertifiedPyro/PipistrelloArchipelago, home of the Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.3.1, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (6 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.3.1 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (6 versions released).

text.fr: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
